name: prone incline bench alternating flutter kicks
description: Small alternating leg lifts while lying face down on an incline bench, mainly working the glutes and the backs of the thighs.
instructions: Lie face down on a stable incline bench with your hips supported and hold the bench securely.
Extend both legs behind you and keep your trunk steady.
Lift one leg a short way as the other lowers, then alternate at a controlled pace.
Avoid swinging the legs or overextending the lower back.
